enemy.name: Bestial Hou
enemy.flavour_text: Of the same form as the earth, of the same height as the mountains. None amongst the many are its equal, and its name is Hou.

abilities.text: [Inaction] Cannot be attacked; enters 2nd form when <Bestial Ju> is defeated or leaves the field, or when enough time has elapsed, activating all Ancient Statuegeists on the field

[Timeshift] Periodically teleports to a certain tile, reducing the ASPD of your units deployed in the opposite direction of its movement, and increasing the Movement Speed of enemy units moving in the same direction
[Transmogrification] When touched by an enemy other than <Bestial Ju>, removes them from the field, deducts 1 Life Point, deals Arts damage to all your units, and permanently gains increased ATK

[Altruism] Periodically locks on to one of your Operators parallel to it and attacks in a straight line, dealing splash Arts damage to the first Operator hit, and deploying an Ancient Statuegeist on a nearby passable tile

[Transmogrification] Causes all enemies other than <Bestial Ju> to move towards this unit until it is defeated or leaves the field; when touched by an enemy other than <Bestial Ju>, removes them from the field, deducts 1 Life Point, deals Arts damage to all your units, and permanently gains increased ATK
[Timeshift] Periodically reduces the ASPD of your units deployed in the opposite direction of its movement, and increasing the Movement Speed of enemy units moving in the same direction
When a long time has passed in the battle, disappears and drains 50 Life Points
